resources.string: Common voltage controls and a guided firmware flow for everyday use.
Shows system parameters, MIPPS, full firmware tools, and logs.
Voltage setting: PPS uses 0.02V steps; AVS (SPR or EPR) uses 0.1V steps. A value outside the required step may fail to negotiate.

A steady light means the requested profile was negotiated. A breathing light means negotiation failed, usually because no PDO information was received. Check whether an AC cable is being used, whether the requested profile exists in the PDO data, and whether it is listed on the charger label.
Tap to fill voltage and current; touch and hold to edit or favorite.
Connect a PD HID device to check firmware.
Grant access to the current USB device first.
Firmware is not ready; local cache will be used first.
Bootloader connected; grant USB access again.
Bootloader and firmware are ready to flash.
Firmware is ready; enter BL mode and authorize it again.
